name: BPC-157
solubility: Soluble in sterile or bacteriostatic water; consult the lot COA for solvent guidance
precis: BPC-157 is a synthetic 15-residue peptide corresponding to a partial sequence of a protein characterized in gastric juice. Its proline-rich core and free termini make it unusually stable in aqueous buffer for a peptide of its length.
narrative_html:
Reading the sequence

Three features of Gly-Glu-Pro-Pro-Pro-Gly-Lys-Pro-Ala-Asp-Asp-Ala-Gly-Leu-Val determine how this material behaves at the bench.

The three consecutive prolines at positions 3-5, with a fourth at position 8, make roughly a quarter of the chain conformationally locked. Proline's ring restricts backbone rotation, and rigid segments are poor substrates for endopeptidases, which require an extended geometry to bind.

No cysteine means no disulfide chemistry: no reduction risk, no dimerization, no scrambling. Reducing agents in a buffer are simply irrelevant here.

No methionine and no tryptophan removes the two most oxidation-prone residues. Light and dissolved oxygen matter far less for this peptide than for a sequence such as Semax.

The net result is an unusually forgiving research material. One lysine and a free N-terminal amine against one glutamate and two aspartates gives a roughly balanced, mildly acidic molecule with good aqueous solubility and — because there are only two basic sites — a comparatively low counterion load.

name: GHK-Cu
solubility: Soluble in water; the copper complex is pH sensitive
precis: GHK-Cu is the copper(II) complex of the tripeptide glycyl-histidyl-lysine. The blue colour of the solid comes from the coordinated copper ion; the free peptide is colourless.
narrative_html:
The copper is the product

GHK-Cu is a coordination complex rather than a peptide alone, and that changes several handling rules.

The tripeptide chelates copper(II) through the N-terminal amine, the deprotonated backbone amide nitrogen between glycine and histidine, and the histidine imidazole — a square-planar geometry typical of copper(II). The lysine side chain remains free.

Because coordination depends on amide deprotonation, the complex is pH-sensitive: below roughly pH 5 it begins to dissociate and release free copper. Chelators strip it — EDTA and similar agents are incompatible. Reducing agents alter it, since copper(II) reduced to copper(I) changes the coordination chemistry entirely.

On a certificate, an ICP-MS elemental screen reporting substantial copper is correct rather than alarming. The useful question is whether copper content matches the expected stoichiometry, which makes it an orthogonal identity check rather than an impurity finding.

The blue colour is diagnostic. Free GHK is colourless; the complex absorbs in the visible region through a d-d transition. White powder in a vial labelled GHK-Cu is a problem visible before the vial is opened.

name: Ipamorelin
solubility: Soluble in sterile or bacteriostatic water; consult the lot COA for solvent guidance
precis: Ipamorelin is a synthetic pentapeptide growth-hormone secretagogue containing two non-proteinogenic residues (Aib and D-2-naphthylalanine) and a C-terminal amide, used as a reference standard in ghrelin-receptor assays.
narrative_html:
Four non-standard positions out of five

Aib at position 1 — alanine with a second alpha-carbon methyl, achiral, helix-favouring and a poor aminopeptidase substrate. His at position 2 is the only conventional proteinogenic residue in the sequence. D-2-Nal at position 3 is 2-naphthylalanine in the D configuration — two departures from standard in one position. D-Phe at position 4. Lys-NH₂ at position 5, amidated to remove the terminal negative charge and block carboxypeptidase attack.

Analytical implications

A theoretical mass calculated from a plain five-letter sequence with proteinogenic residue masses will be substantially wrong.

The D substitutions are invisible to mass spectrometry — D-2-Nal and L-2-Nal are isobaric, as are D-Phe and L-Phe. Confirming stereochemistry requires chiral analysis, which is not routine on a research certificate.

Racemization during synthesis is therefore a real impurity class for this peptide: the resulting diastereomers have the correct mass and may or may not resolve chromatographically depending on the method.

Storage is undemanding — no cysteine, methionine, asparagine or glutamine. The two aromatic residues are mildly photosensitive, making dark storage sensible without being critical.

name: Retatrutide
solubility: Soluble in sterile or bacteriostatic water; consult the lot COA for solvent guidance
precis: Retatrutide is a synthetic 39-residue lipidated peptide analogue carrying activity at the GIP, GLP-1 and glucagon receptors. It is supplied lyophilized as an analytical reference material for in-vitro receptor and signalling work.
narrative_html:
Triple-receptor design

GIP, GLP-1 and glucagon belong to the same peptide hormone family, sharing an evolutionary origin and a common class B G-protein-coupled receptor. That homology is what makes multi-receptor engagement possible at all — but each receptor has distinct preferences at particular positions, so a sequence engaging all three must satisfy three overlapping and partly conflicting sets of constraints while retaining the modifications needed for stability.

Why no sequence is published here

A plain 39-letter residue string would omit the Aib substitutions that block dipeptidyl peptidase-4 cleavage, the acylation site, the linker chemistry and the fatty acid — that is, most of what distinguishes this molecule from a generic peptide of the same length. Identity confirmation rests on mass spectrometry against the complete modified structure, which is what the lot certificate records.

Analytical and handling notes

Strongly hydrophobic for its length, owing to the lipid: late reversed-phase retention, readily adsorbed to plastic, and aggregation-prone under agitation. Vortexing causes visible loss. At 4,731.4 g/mol a single-residue deletion shifts mass by 1-3% and a +16 oxidation by 0.3%, so high-resolution measurement or a well-resolved LC-MS gradient is the appropriate method.

name: Semaglutide
solubility: Soluble in sterile or bacteriostatic water; consult the lot COA for solvent guidance
precis: Semaglutide is a 31-residue GLP-1 receptor agonist analogue with an Aib substitution at position 8 and a C18 diacid side chain, widely used as a reference standard in incretin-receptor research.
narrative_html:
Two problems, two modifications

Native GLP-1 fails on two independent counts, and semaglutide addresses each separately.

Dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inactivates native GLP-1 within minutes by cleaving after alanine 8. Semaglutide substitutes Aib — 2-aminoisobutyric acid — at that position. Its two alpha-carbon methyls make it achiral and sterically hindered, and DPP-4 cannot process it.

Renal filtration clears a 4,000-dalton peptide within hours even when protected from enzymes. Semaglutide attaches a C18 fatty diacid to lysine 26 through a linker built from gamma-glutamate and two short ethylene glycol spacers. The fatty acid binds reversibly to serum albumin; the complex is far too large to be filtered, and only the small free fraction is available for clearance or for receptor engagement.

Either modification alone would be insufficient — the two address different mechanisms and their effect is multiplicative.

Handling

The C18 diacid makes this molecule considerably more hydrophobic than an unmodified 31-mer: late reversed-phase retention, meaningful adsorption to labware, and — unusually — greater aggregation risk in concentrated solution than dilute, since the exposed lipid seeks a hydrophobic environment and often finds another semaglutide molecule.

name: Semax
solubility: Soluble in sterile or bacteriostatic water; consult the lot COA for solvent guidance
precis: Semax is a synthetic heptapeptide combining the ACTH(4-7) fragment with a C-terminal Pro-Gly-Pro tripeptide, an extension that markedly slows enzymatic degradation relative to the ACTH fragment alone.
narrative_html:
The Pro-Gly-Pro strategy

The first four residues — Met-Glu-His-Phe — are positions 4-7 of adrenocorticotropic hormone. On its own that tetrapeptide is degraded very quickly by aminopeptidases. The appended Pro-Gly-Pro tail is the entire design: proline-containing motifs are poor peptidase substrates, and the C-terminal extension markedly increases the fragment's survival in biological media.

Selank uses the same tail on an entirely different parent sequence, which makes the pairing a design pattern rather than a coincidence.

The methionine at position 1

This is the single most important handling fact about Semax. Methionine oxidizes to the sulfoxide at +16 daltons, and an N-terminal residue is maximally exposed to solvent and oxygen. A mass spectrum of aged Semax commonly shows a +16 satellite.

Practical consequences: store lyophilized, cold, dark and desiccated; reconstitute in degassed buffer where feasible; consider low-concentration EDTA to chelate the trace metals that catalyse the reaction; and do not leave solutions at room temperature. Amber vials genuinely earn their cost for this peptide, since the phenylalanine adds photosensitivity alongside the methionine.

name: TB-500
solubility: Soluble in sterile or bacteriostatic water; consult the lot COA for solvent guidance
precis: TB-500 is the N-acetylated heptapeptide corresponding to the actin-binding domain (residues 17-23) of thymosin beta-4. It is a fragment analogue, not full-length Tβ4, and the two are frequently conflated in vendor listings.
narrative_html:
A fragment, not the parent protein

TB-500 is routinely described as "synthetic thymosin beta-4." It is not. Thymosin beta-4 is a 43-residue protein of roughly 4,960 g/mol. TB-500 as supplied by essentially every research vendor is the seven-residue acetylated fragment corresponding to residues 17-23, at 889.02 g/mol — about a fifth of the parent's mass.

The distinction is worth checking on any certificate. A product sold as TB-500 whose stated mass sits near 4,960 is full-length Tβ4; one at 889 is the fragment. Vendor pages that quote the parent's residue count alongside the fragment's formula are internally inconsistent, and that inconsistency is a useful signal about how the copy was produced.

Handling notes

N-terminal acetylation adds 42 daltons and blocks aminopeptidase attack. Two lysines give the peptide net positive character despite the glutamate, so counterion load is meaningful and adsorption to negatively charged plastic is worth considering at dilute working concentrations. The C-terminal glutamine is a slow deamidation site — a reason not to store solutions alkaline, though far less pressing than an asparagine would be.

name: Tirzepatide
solubility: Soluble in sterile or bacteriostatic water; consult the lot COA for solvent guidance
precis: Tirzepatide is a synthetic 39-residue peptide bearing a C20 fatty diacid moiety, studied as a dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist in laboratory receptor-pharmacology models.
narrative_html:
Dual agonism as a design constraint

GIP and GLP-1 are related hormones acting at related receptors, with homologous but non-identical sequences. A single molecule engaging both must satisfy two sets of binding requirements simultaneously — a harder problem than single-receptor optimization, and part of why the molecule is longer than semaglutide. More residues means more positions available to reconcile competing constraints.

The stabilization strategy is the family standard: Aib substitutions to block dipeptidyl peptidase-4 cleavage, and a C20 fatty diacid through a linker for reversible albumin binding and extended circulation. The C20 chain is two carbons longer than semaglutide's.

Consequences of size

At 39 residues, coupling efficiency compounds unfavourably: crude purity is lower and more purification is needed, which is reflected in cost per milligram. Deletion sequences shift mass by 1-3% and may barely move retention time, so LC-MS rather than UV-only chromatography is the appropriate release method.

The longer lipid makes it more hydrophobic than semaglutide — later retention, greater adsorption to labware, and a stronger tendency to aggregate in concentrated solution. Reconstitute gently, aliquot immediately, and prepare working dilutions fresh.
